blocks.text: Algorithms masle hal karne ke qadam ba qadam tareeqe (procedures) hain, bilkul jaise recipe khana pakane ke qadam batati hai. Yeh computer science ki backbone (reerh ki haddi, sab se zaroori hissa) hain aur machines ko kaam efficiently (kam waqt aur kam memory mein) karne ke qabil banate hain. Algorithms samajhna zaroori hai kyun ke software ke har kaam ke peeche inhi ki logic (mantiq) hoti hai; in se hum mushkil masle hal karte hain, performance behtar (optimize) karte hain aur alag alag applications mein accuracy (sahi hona) pakka karte hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Google search engine ek complex (mushkil) algorithm PageRank istemal karta hai jo tay karta hai ke koi web page kitna relevant (talash se juda hua) hai. Yeh algorithm kai cheezein dekhta hai, jaise kisi page ki taraf aane wale links ki ginti aur un links ka quality (achhai), aur phir search results mein pages ki tarteeb (rank) banata hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Algorithms seekhte waqt unhein rozmarra ke un kaamon se jorein jo aap pehle se jante hain. Is se samajh aayega ke algorithms kaise kaam karte hain aur kyun ahem hain.

blocks.prompt: Recipe algorithm ki achhi misal kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Recipe saaf qadmon ki finite (khatam hone wali) aur tarteeb wali list hai jo diye gaye inputs (ingredients, khane ki cheezein) ko nateeje (khane) mein badalti hai; algorithm bhi yahi karta hai.

items: Algorithm: recipe jaisa qadam ba qadam tareeqa; PageRank links ki ginti aur quality se web pages ki tarteeb banata hai.
